definitions.explanation: The closing portion of the current month — roughly the last week or so, or the final day depending on context. Combines {今月|こんげつ} (this month) with {末|まつ} (end). Standard in business and scheduling contexts.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}りは{今月末|こんげつまつ}だ。
examples.english: The deadline is the end of this month.

examples.japanese: {今月末|こんげつまつ}までに{報告書|ほうこくしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the report by the end of this month.

examples.japanese: {今月末|こんげつまつ}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すので、{荷造|にづく}りで{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: I'm moving at the end of this month, so I'm busy packing.

notes:
Frequently appears in deadlines, contracts, and payment schedules. The suffix {末|まつ} marks the closing portion of a unit of time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}まで: by the end of this month
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}までに: by the end of this month (with deadline nuance)
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}{締|し}め{切|き}り: end-of-month deadline
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}{払|ばら}い: end-of-month payment

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {月末|げつまつ}: end of the month (any month)
- {来月末|らいげつまつ}: end of next month
- {先月末|せんげつまつ}: end of last month
- {年末|ねんまつ}: end of the year
- {月初|げっしょ}: beginning of the month
